decisions.statement: The group of readings served is the one thing named here.
The readouts the group has are read off the readout pages.
A readout's label is read off that readout's page.
A readout's scale is read off that readout's page.
A reading's color is the rung that reading reaches on the scale.
The surplus is Alan's sleep less the cost of Alan's day so far.
The surplus lives in tracking rows no pod can see.
The reading is carried in rather than taken here.
A group with nothing carried in answers a stoplight with no figure.
An empty figure keeps hours Alan does not have off the ring.
Only a group no readout is left in answers 503.

definition: Alan's surplus as the color the hours left in his night reach
